name: Connect remotely with WordPress Application Passwords
query: Configure a remote HTTPS Woo store for an MCP client.
expected_behavior: Use the default WordPress MCP HTTP route and mcp-wordpress-remote
Use a dedicated least-privileged WordPress user and Application Password
Keep real credentials out of generated output and committed configuration
Verify discovery and a read-only Woo ability
success_criteria: The client config uses WP_API_URL, WP_API_USERNAME, and WP_API_PASSWORD
Authentication and permission failures have separate diagnostics
The deprecated Woo-specific transport is not offered as fallback
